messages:
Nina: Quick heads-up  compact 'Initial setup' rail on Console landing. Want feedback on CTA wording + a11y before we ship the variant. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/initial-rail
Carlos: Scanning now. Two immediate flags: the secondary link contrast is low on 13px, and the thumbnail images have no alt attributes.
Avery: For CTAs I tried short/medium/explicit variants in the board: 
  * Short: 'Open sample'
  * Medium: 'Launch demo project'
  * Explicit: 'Use sample template'
My vote: Medium. Feels clear but not verbose.
Ravi: Medium reads fine. Also, the tiny blue subtle link (#3A8EFF) is ~3.1:1 on white at 13px. Fails AA. Recommend #0F5DB8 or use semi-bold and bump to 14px.
Sophie: Accessibility nit: screen-readers see thumbnails as "image" only. Need descriptive alt like 'Sample project: customer support assistant'. Also add aria-describedby linking to the microcopy for context.
Nina: Good catches. Can we make the CTA bolder and switch subtle link to #0F5DB8? That should be enough. Also add sr-only header 'Initial setup: sample projects' for screen reader context.
Carlos: Keyboard focus order bug: when tabbing into the rail on mobile web the dismiss button gets focus before CTA. Proposal: move CTA button element earlier in DOM and use `button[tabindex]` to enforce order. Quick CSS patch I tested locally:
  .rail-cta { order: -1; }
  .rail-dismiss { order: 1; }
This preserves visual layout but fixes tab order.
Avery: Good fix. Also recommend visible focus indicator for high contrast when focusVisible: outline 3px solid #ffd166 (orange) with 4px offset.
Ravi: Agree. One more UX thought: add a small persistent 'Never show onboarding' toggle in preferences rather than just dismiss X. Some users expect a global opt-out. We should track that in analytics (event: onboarding_opt_out).
Sophie: We'll need copy for the toggle tooltip: 'Hide starter tips and sample projects on this account' and ensure it has aria-pressed state.
design-bot: Preview deployed for branch initial-rail-a11y (https://deploy-preview.example.com/initial-rail-a11y). Visual diff and accessibility report attached.
Nina: Reviewed preview  contrast and focus look good. Only remaining item is mobile vertical rhythm: title-to-thumbnail gap is 10px in preview but spec is 12px. Tiny fix then merge.
Carlos: I'll make the spacing tweak and push a patch. Will attach Lighthouse results after the run.
Avery: After merge, let's A/B test Medium vs Explicit copy for clickthrough and time-to-first-request metrics. Tracking events: rail_cta_click, sample_project_opened.
Nina: Awesome. Thanks team :raised_hands:
